questions.question_en:
Consider the following statements :-
 (1) Tropical deserts in the world are found in the trade 
wind bands of western ends of Continents-
 (2) In India, Eastern Himalayan region receives more 
rain from North-eastern winds.
 Which among the above statements is/are/ correct ?
 Code :
questions.question_hi:
[विश्व का भूगोल: भू-आकृति विज्ञान — चट्टानें, ज्वालामुखी, भूकंप, पर्वत, मरुस्थल एवं घास के मैदान • I.A.S. (Pre) 2009]
निम्नलिखित कथनों पर विचार कीजिए:
Consider the following statements :-
 (1) Tropical deserts in the world are found in the trade 
wind bands of western ends of Continents-
 (2) In India, Eastern Himalayan region receives more 
rain from North-eastern winds.
 Which among the above statements is/are/ correct ?
 Code :
questions.explanation_en:
Tropical hot deserts are often found in the region of trade 
wind band between 150 to 300 South or North of Equator in the 
western side of continents. Therefore statement 1 is correct. In 
India, Eastern Himalayan region receives more rain from the 
Southwest winds coming from the Bay of Bengal. Therefore 
statement 2 is wrong.
questions.explanation_hi:
आधिकारिक उत्तर कुंजी (I.A.S. (Pre) 2009): विकल्प (A) सही है।
विस्तृत व्याख्या (Ghatnachakra Official Notes):
Tropical hot deserts are often found in the region of trade 
wind band between 150 to 300 South or North of Equator in the 
western side of continents. Therefore statement 1 is correct. In 
India, Eastern Himalayan region receives more rain from the 
Southwest winds coming from the Bay of Bengal. Therefore 
statement 2 is wrong.
